title: The Drive For Humanoids And Posthumans: What Future Is Africa Preparing For?
deck: The next contest is not simply between humans and machines. It is between societies that decide how intelligence will be used and societies that allow others to decide for them.

notes: Editorial note: This is an opinion article. Statements about transhumanism and posthuman life describe ideas and proposals, not demonstrated scientific outcomes. Figures from Microsoft are estimates derived from its research method, not national censuses. Employment-impact and GDP figures describe exposure, projections or scenarios, not realised changes. The business example is explicitly hypothetical.
